title: A traceback, read bottom-up
caption: Python prints the call chain in the order it was built, so the useful end is the bottom. Start at the last line for the fact, then climb one frame at a time for the route. The first frame naming a file you wrote is almost always the one to open.

cells.label: 1 · last line
cells.note: the error's name and what it objected to: ValueError on 'twelve'

cells.label: 2 · frame above it
cells.note: the call that was running when it broke: read_cents, line 5

cells.label: 3 · next frame up
cells.note: who called that, and from which line: total, line 11

cells.label: 4 · top frame
cells.note: where the program started. Skip it unless the rest made no sense.
